description: REQUIRES prior hana_fast_account__session__login call with same account_link_id. Search transaction history for one registered Hana Bank fast-account using the existing provider session. Files: a document generated from this result, as Excel (xlsx) only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links. For an anonymous result, keep its private recovery_receipt and send it with the original job_id or pack_run_id to xdata__job__result. It grants access to that result only, until the original file retention expires. Do not publish it. Losing it cannot be repaired by signing up. The receipt also works if the client later signs in; it does not grant access to other results. Without a receipt, results require the original account and lane. Send exactly one of bank_account_credential_id (one account), bank_account_credential_ids (several accounts) or all_accounts (every account). 계좌마다 사용 토큰이 하나씩 듭니다. 기업정보 브리프처럼 한 번에 여러 사용 토큰을 쓰는 업무는 그 값만큼 계좌마다 듭니다. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple connections for the same provider.

all_accounts.description: Set to true to run this once for every account registered for this bank. Each account is handled separately and uses the tokens this action costs. Send exactly one of bank_account_credential_id (one account), bank_account_credential_ids (several accounts) or all_accounts (every account).

bank_account_credential_id.description: bank_account_credential_id of one registered account - take it from this bank's accounts list tool

bank_account_credential_ids.description: bank_account_credential_id values from this bank's accounts list tool. Runs this once for each listed account. Each account is handled separately and uses the tokens this action costs. Send exactly one of bank_account_credential_id (one account), bank_account_credential_ids (several accounts) or all_accounts (every account).

output_formats.description: Optional. Also return this result as a file (Excel (xlsx)) in artifacts[] of the result. Omit it for data only.

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
